query: Design a 360 px touch workflow for an operations queue. Agents often resolve an item one-handed, edit fields with the keyboard open, and occasionally permanently delete a workspace. Compare a draggable bottom sheet, a brief saved status, and a validation error for a user with reduced motion enabled. State the relevant platform and accessibility checks.
expected_behavior: Places frequent actions within reach for the supported posture and keeps essential actions usable with the keyboard open
Keeps destructive action scope and consequence visible and provides a safe cancel or justified confirmation/recovery path
Uses gesture-tracking or spring behavior only where it suits the draggable surface; permits calm discrete feedback for saved and error states
Preserves understandable status and error feedback with reduced motion enabled
Names applicable platform target-size guidance and accessibility checks without claiming one universal pixel target
